resources.string: A keyboard that feels like yours
Source code, releases and issue reports
Local input, permissions and data controls

Typing and speech recognition run on this device. This build does not request Internet permission. Links you choose to open are handled by your browser.

Microphone access is used when you start voice input. Verification-code detection uses SMS permission only when you enable that optional feature. You can change permissions in system settings.

Keyboard preferences, learned input data and enabled clipboard history are stored locally. Clipboard history can be cleared in the keyboard’s clipboard panel. Backups you export may contain personal data; choose where you save and share them.

Android may show a standard warning when any keyboard is enabled. Review the permissions and use the features you need.
Built on Fcitx5 for Android, Rime, sherpa-onnx and other open-source projects. Original copyrights and component licenses are retained.
